description: Autologic Industries exports bike engine components for Sri Lanka, precision-made to OEM tolerances with quality checks at every production stage.
banner_desc: Engine parts for Sri Lankan motorcycles, made to fit right the first time.
hero_sub: Engine Rebuilds That Go Back Together Properly
hero: Nothing frustrates a service centre more than an engine part that needs filing before it fits. Our bike engine components for Sri Lanka are produced to OEM tolerances, so rebuilds go back together the way they came apart.
We machine and cast them on our own CNC and die casting lines at an IATF 16949 certified plant, checking quality at every stage.
Testing covers difficult road and weather conditions, which suits an island with tropical heat, monsoon rain and steep hill roads.
Components can travel in the same container as clutch parts, keeping freight to Colombo economical.

faq_intro: Questions from Sri Lankan service centres about our engine parts.
faqs: Will the parts need adjusting to fit?
No. They are produced to OEM tolerances for the models they suit.
How do you check quality?
At every stage of production, plus testing for demanding road and weather conditions.
Can you produce a part we cannot find?
Send a sample or drawing; after a feasibility review we can produce it, with a first article for approval.
Can I combine engine and clutch parts?
Yes, in one container to Colombo.
Do you accept small orders?
Yes. Trial quantities are welcome.
Can parts be packed under our brand?
Yes, with your part numbers.
How do I confirm fitment?
Send model names, OEM numbers or a sample.
Do you provide technical support after delivery?
Yes. Our team can answer fitting and specification questions from your service centres.
Are these parts suitable for motorcycles used for deliveries?
Yes. They are made for steady daily use, and accurate fit helps engines cope with the long hours delivery riders put in.
Can engine parts be split between outlets?
Yes, cartons can be labelled for each branch before shipping.
